scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic counting and convexity proof given. Finite independent computations are diagnostics only, not a substitute for the infinite proof. No claim of external or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to a union of two nonempty integer intervals each of length at least two; it does not resolve the arbitrary-finite-set or arbitrary-gapset interval question, nor establish unimodality of the Buchweitz difference. Equivalent results under other additive-combinatorial terminology remain a literature risk.
title: Interval-shaped Buchweitz support for unions of two integer intervals
